scope: Original images013v–023v; Kilayim/Sheviit and boundary material
method: Original images of all 21 pages inspected; all 42 main columns independently transcribed as uncertain consonantal reading attempts, then exact consonantal sequences bound in order to the source-location map. A separate small set of clear individual point signs was recorded visually and only then compared to source-bound Accordance anchors. No inferred/completed pointing is recorded as manuscript observation.
